notes: 600 active seconds, fixed nearby positions, existing real feeding/resources and .5 tick; no added meals or hunger resets.
Food fixtures recursively include up to three real prey and their first defined food, not an unlimited prey supply. An interval is only reported when >=2 actual meals exist.
These measurements are conditional fixture results, not wild feeding intervals. A single/no meal has null mean. Worm litter feeding is separate; colonies have no consumer hunger.
